title: DiVE: DiT-based Video Generation with Enhanced Control
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: multi-view video (temporally and cross-view consistent), 16-frame clips extended autoregressively

control_signal.value: BEV instance layouts (2D coordinates, heading, ID, instance captions), road sketches, and scene text caption, all derived from 3D geometry by projection

control_mechanism.value: Caption-layout joint cross-attention (Fourier-encoded layout plus CLIP instance captions via MLP), ControlNet-Transformer with 13 duplicated blocks for road sketch, and classifier-free guidance with separate scales for text, layout, sketch.

base_model.value: OpenSora 1.1 spatial-temporal DiT with frozen LDM VAE and T5 text encoder; parameter-free spatial view-inflated attention for cross-view consistency; rectified flow in later training stages.

datasets.value: nuScenes with interpolated 12Hz annotations, for both training and evaluation.

metrics.value: FVD, DINO and CLIP temporal consistency, MUSIQ imaging quality; controllability via BEVFormer object mAP (3D detection) and map mIoU (BEV segmentation) on generated videos.

controllability_evidence.value: Against MagicDrive (Table 1): FVD 94.60 vs 221.90, object mAP 24.55 vs 11.73, map mIoU 35.96 vs 18.44. CFG ablation (Table 2) also supports the layout/sketch guidance.

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop generation only. Evaluated on 16-frame sequences; longer video produced autoregressively with last-k frames conditioning the next clip.

notes: Limits passage in the packet was empty. Abstract mentions corner cases but evidence shown is qualitative plus Table 1. Short workshop-style paper.
